name: Carburo
description:
**Carburo** is a .NET MAUI app for iOS and Android that helps drivers find cheaper fuel stations and EV charging points across several European countries.

It features interactive maps, location-based search, price comparison, favorites and alerts, with dedicated **Apple CarPlay and Android Auto** experiences.

The app uses a custom MAUI UI with SkiaSharp and connects to an ASP.NET Core backend with PostgreSQL/PostGIS.
author: Infoscape Software
